decision: DIFFERS -> W1, ROW DEFAULT (worklist 56 §5: no see_layout). Today's [36,48] is on no cited page (it matches only USU's MOUND spacing, 4 ft). clemson_hgic 'Cantaloupe & Honeydew Melons' (names honeydew): "Transplants or seed should be planted in the rows 18 to 24 inches apart." -> in_row [18,24]; "Plant the melons in rows 6 to 8 feet apart." -> rows [72,96]. CHOSEN over the worklist's USU row ("Transplants should be planted 2 feet apart in row, with rows 4-6 feet apart", [24,24]/[48,72]) because Clemson is a range, names honeydew in its title and sentence ('Cantaloupes and honeydews need a lot of space'), and is exactly the crop's own prose (soil_prep, thinning: 18-24 in, rows 6-8 ft), so no consumer string moves. NON-DEFAULT hill-none from usu_ext (winter melons incl. honeydew): "Plant 4-6 seeds in mounds 4 feet apart. After they have two leaves, thin to two plants per mound." -> hills [48,48], plants_per_hill [2,2], rows not_authored (USU's mound sentence has no between-hill-rows figure; on a non-default entry that is only not_authored). A hill default here would have shipped see_layout. Every restatement already agrees.
